scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
I await for the master
whom destiny will choose
for me. Do you think you
have to courage and strength
to conquer this stronghold?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我等待着命运为我选定的主人。你认为你有勇气和力量征服这座要塞吗？

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Hmpf. Your threats don't
scare me! Guardians, drive
this infidel away from here!
I will always be loyal to the
master of this stronghold,
the one and only ^FF0000{0}^000000.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
哼。你的威胁吓不倒我！守卫们，把这个异教徒赶出去！我将永远忠于这座要塞的主人，唯一的^FF0000{0}^000000。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Ah, Master ^FF0000{0}^000000...
How shall I serve you today?
Was there an aspect of this
stronghold's maintenance
you wanted to discuss?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
啊，主人^FF0000{0}^000000……
今天我要如何为您效劳？
您想讨论关于这座要塞维护的哪些方面吗？

scripts.text: Stronghold Briefing
scripts.translation: 要塞简报

scripts.text: Invest in Commercial Growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Invest in Defense growth
scripts.translation: 投资防御发展

scripts.text: Hire/Fire Storage Staff
scripts.translation: 雇佣/解雇仓库职员

scripts.text: Go to Master's room
scripts.translation: 去主人房间

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
The Commercial Growth
Level of the stronghold is ^0000ff{0}.
Last time, you invested in
Commercial Growth {1}.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
要塞的商业发展等级为^0000ff{0}。
上次，您投资了商业发展{1}次。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
The Commercial Growth
Level of the stronghold is ^0000ff{0}.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
要塞的商业发展等级为^0000ff{0}。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Our stronghold's
safeguard level is {0}.
Last time, you invested
in defense {1} times.
 
That is all, master.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我们要塞的防御等级是{0}。
上次，您投资了防御{1}次。
 
就这些了，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Our stronghold's
safeguard level is {0}.
 
That is all, master.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我们要塞的防御等级是{0}。
 
就这些了，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Raising the stronghold's
commercial growth will
increase the quantity of
goods produced for the guild.
Investing in commercial growth
will help the guild's future.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
提高要塞的商业发展将增加为公会生产的商品数量。
投资商业发展将有助于公会的未来。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You can make one investment
each day, but if you can make
two investments if you pay
more Zeny: this will speed
up commercial development,
but can be quite expensive.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您每天可以进行一次投资，但如果支付更多泽尼，您可以进行两次投资：这将加快商业发展，但可能相当昂贵。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
However, our stronghold's
commerical growth level is
at 100%. It's not possible to
develop commercial growth
any further than that.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
然而，我们要塞的商业发展等级已达到100%。不可能再进一步发展商业了。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You've already made two
investments today, so you'll
have to wait until tomorrow
to make another investment.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您今天已经进行了两次投资，所以必须等到明天才能再次投资。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You must pay ^FF0000{0}^000000 Zeny
to make an investment
Will you invest in this
stronghold's commerical
development now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您必须支付^FF0000{0}^000000泽尼来进行投资。
您现在要投资这座要塞的商业发展吗？

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You must pay ^FF0000{0}^000000
more Zeny to make a second
investment today. Will you
invest one more time?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您必须再支付^FF0000{0}^000000泽尼才能今天进行第二次投资。您要再投资一次吗？

scripts.text: Invest in Commercial Growth
scripts.translation: 投资商业发展

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You've already made two
investments today, so you'll
have to wait until tomorrow
to make another investment.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您今天已经进行了两次投资，所以必须等到明天才能再次投资。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
I'm sorry, Master, but
you do not have enough
Zeny to make an investment
for the guild today.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
抱歉，主人，但您的泽尼不足以今天为公会进行投资。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
A wise use of the guild's
funds, Master. We can expect
to see the results of this
investment by tomorrow.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智地使用公会资金，主人。我们可以期待明天看到这次投资的结果。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
As you command, Master.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
遵命，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Investing in our stronghold's
defense will enhance the
durability of our Guardians
and the Emperium. We'll need
every advantage to protect
ourselves from our enemies.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
投资我们要塞的防御将增强我们的守卫和华丽金属的耐久性。我们需要每一个优势来保护自己免受敌人的侵害。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
You can invest in defense
once per day, but if you pay
more Zeny, you can invest
a maximum of two times daily.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您每天可以投资一次防御，但如果支付更多泽尼，您每天最多可以投资两次。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
The Defense Level of this
stronghold is 100%, and
cannot be increased further.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
这座要塞的防御等级是100%，无法再增加。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Master, you've already
invested in Defense twice
today. You'll need to wait
until tomorrow if you really
want to increase our defenses.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
主人，您今天已经投资了两次防御。如果您真的想增加我们的防御，您需要等到明天。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
We need ^FF0000{0}^000000
Zeny to invest in our
stronghold's defenses.
Will you invest now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我们需要^FF0000{0}^000000泽尼来投资我们要塞的防御。
您现在要投资吗？

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
We need ^FF0000{0}^000000
Zeny to invest in our
stronghold's defenses
a second time today.
Will you invest now?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我们需要^FF0000{0}^000000泽尼来今天第二次投资我们要塞的防御。
您现在要投资吗？

scripts.text: Invest in Defense
scripts.translation: 投资防御

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Master, you've already
invested in Defense twice
today. You'll need to wait
until tomorrow if you really
want to increase our defenses.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
主人，您今天已经投资了两次防御。如果您真的想增加我们的防御，您需要等到明天。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
I'm sorry, Master, but
you do not have enough
Zeny to make an investment
for the guild today.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
抱歉，主人，但您的泽尼不足以今天为公会进行投资。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
A wise use of the guild's
funds, Master. Increasing
the frequency of treasure
procured by the guild will
definitely help us all.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
明智地使用公会资金，主人。增加公会获取宝物的频率肯定会对我们所有人有帮助。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
As you command, Master.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
遵命，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Do you wish to dismiss
the Kafra Employee that
we've hired for the guild?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您希望解雇我们为公会雇佣的卡普拉服务员吗？

scripts.text: Dismiss
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Master, please reconsider!
I've been working very hard
for the success of the guild!
I'll try harder to serve the
guild members of this
stronghold, I promise!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
主人，请 reconsider！
我一直为公会的成功努力工作！
我会更努力地服务于这座要塞的公会成员，我保证！

scripts.text: Dismiss
scripts.translation: 解雇

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Why?! What have I done
to deserve this? Waaah~!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
为什么？！我做错了什么要受到这种待遇？哇啊啊~！

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
Thank you, Master!
I'll obey your every
command as best I can!
You won't regret this!
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
谢谢您，主人！
我会尽我所能服从您的每一个命令！
您不会后悔的！

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
She works very hard,
in my opinion. It was in
all of our best interests to
allow her to stay with us.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
在我看来，她工作非常努力。让她留在我们身边符合我们所有人的最佳利益。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
That Kafra Employee
has been dismissed.
Were really dissatisfied
by the quality of her service?
scripts.translation:
[管家]
那名卡普拉服务员已被解雇。
您真的对她的服务质量不满意吗？

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Will you hire a
Kafra Employee to serve
our stronghold? You must
pay ^FF000010,000 Zeny^000000 to hire one.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您要雇佣一名卡普拉服务员来服务我们的要塞吗？您必须支付^FF000010,000泽尼^000000来雇佣一名。

scripts.text: Hire
scripts.translation: 雇佣

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Master, we cannot hire a
Kafra Employee because
you have not yet attained
the ^FF0000Contract with Kafra^000000
guild skill.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
主人，我们无法雇佣卡普拉服务员，因为您尚未获得^FF0000和卡普拉订契约^000000公会技能。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Master, we cannot hire a
Kafra Employee because
we do not have enough
funds to pay the contract fee.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
主人，我们无法雇佣卡普拉服务员，因为我们没有足够的资金支付契约费用。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Very well. We have formed
a contract with the Kafra
Head Office, and hired a
Kafra Employee for our
stronghold. Here she is~
scripts.translation:
[管家]
很好。我们已经与卡普拉总部签订了契约，并为我们的要塞雇佣了一名卡普拉服务员。她在这里~

scripts.text:
[ Hired Kafra Employee ]
How do you do? I've
been dispatched by the
Kafra Head Office to
serve your guild's needs.
I'll do my best to follow
your every command, Master.
scripts.translation:
[受雇的卡普拉服务员]
您好？我由卡普拉总部派遣来服务您公会的需求。
我会尽最大努力服从您的每一个命令，主人。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Our contract will expire
after one month, so we must
pay additional fees to keep
this Kafra Employee in
the service of our guild.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
我们的契约将在一个月后到期，所以我们必须支付额外费用才能让这名卡普拉服务员继续为我们公会服务。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
As you command, Master.
However, I suggest hiring
a Kafra Employee as soon
as possible since our guild
would greatly benefit from
the convenient Kafra services.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
遵命，主人。
不过，我建议尽快雇佣一名卡普拉服务员，因为我们的公会将极大地受益于便捷的卡普拉服务。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Do you wish to enter the
Guild Treasure Room?
Only you, the Guild Master,
are permitted to enter.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
您希望进入公会宝物室吗？
只有您，公会会长，才被允许进入。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Please remember to open
the Treasure Boxes at the
proper time. Otherwise, the
treasure may disappear if
something unexpected happens.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
请记住在适当的时间打开宝物箱子。否则，如果发生意外情况，宝物可能会消失。

scripts.text: Go to Treasure Room
scripts.translation: 去宝物室

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Allow me to guide you
on the secret path to
the Treasure Room.
Press the secret switch
when you wish to return here.
scripts.translation:
[管家]
让我引导您走上通往宝物室的秘密路径。
当您想回到这里时，请按动秘密开关。

scripts.text:
[ Steward ]
Items in the Treasure Room
are produced once each day.
Therefore, you must obtain
the treasure items everyday.
For the sake of the guild,
prioritize treasure harvesting!
scripts.translation:
[管家]
宝物室中的物品每天生产一次。
因此，您必须每天获取宝物物品。
为了公会着想，优先采集宝物！

scripts.text:
{0}
Great job. Now, all you
need to do is destroy this
Emperium to gain ownership
over this stronghold.
scripts.translation:
{0}
干得好。现在，您只需要摧毁这个华丽金属就能获得这座要塞的所有权。

scripts.text:
{0}
As guardian of this
stronghold, I answer only
to the master of the guild
that controls this place.
scripts.translation:
{0}
作为这座要塞的守护者，我只听从控制此地的公会主人的命令。

scripts.text:
{0}
I am {1}, guardian of
this stronghold. For now,
all is quiet in this place.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我是{1}，这座要塞的守护者。目前，这里一切平静。

scripts.text: Converse
scripts.translation: 对话

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

{0}
您对这座要塞有任何疑问吗？

scripts.text: Guardian Stones
scripts.translation: 守护石

scripts.text: Fortress Gates
scripts.translation: 要塞大门

scripts.text: Link Flags
scripts.translation: 连接旗帜

scripts.text: Battle Strategy
scripts.translation: 战斗策略

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
{0}
There is one Emperium
and two Guardian Stones in
each fortress. These stones
are the first line of defense,
and must be destroyed before
enemies can even enter.
scripts.translation:
{0}
每个要塞中有一个华丽金属和两个守护石。这些石头是第一道防线，必须在敌人进入之前被摧毁。

scripts.text:
{0}
The stones are located in
^4D4DFFGate Houses^000000 which must be
protected to prevent enemies
from reaching the Emperium.
Guardian Stones can ^4D4DFFrecall
your Guardians^000000 for protection.
scripts.translation:
{0}
石头位于^4D4DFF门房^000000中，必须加以保护以防止敌人到达华丽金属。守护石可以^4D4DFF召回您的守卫^000000进行保护。

scripts.text:
{0}
Fortresses with higher levels
of defense can summon more
Guardians: this is why it is
so important for guilds to
invest in Defense Growth.
scripts.translation:
{0}
防御等级较高的要塞可以召唤更多的守卫：这就是为什么公会投资防御发展如此重要。

scripts.text:
{0}
Guardian Stones that have
been destroyed can be revived
after a certain time, but one of the guild members must give
me the order. I can also report the status of the Guardian Stones.
scripts.translation:
{0}
被摧毁的守护石可以在一定时间后复活，但必须由一名公会成员向我下达命令。我也可以报告守护石的状态。

scripts.text:
{0}
^4D4DFFFortress Gates^000000 are the second line of guild stronghold defense,
and are protected by extra barricades activated by the Guardian Stones.
These gates are located in three different parts of the fortress.

{0}
Barricades are protected by
Guardian Stones, and are
restored when the Guardian
Stones are retrieved. However,
it is not as easy to restore
destroyed Fortress Gates.
scripts.translation:
{0}
防御线由守护石保护，并在取回守护石时恢复。然而，恢复被摧毁的要塞大门并不那么容易。

scripts.text:
{0}
Fortress Gates can only be
restored when the ^4D4DFFguild
master of a stronghold
changes^000000, or if ^4D4DFFrestoration
is requested by the guild
master of the stronghold^000000.
scripts.translation:
{0}
只有在^4D4DFF要塞的公会会长变更^000000时，或者^4D4DFF由要塞的公会会长请求恢复^000000时，才能恢复要塞大门。

scripts.text:
{0}
Strongholds have many
Link Flags that allow you
to access vital areas within
restrictions placed by the
Barricades. Usually, ^4D4DFFFlag 1
links to the Gate House^000000.
scripts.translation:
{0}
要塞有许多连接旗帜，允许您在防御线设置的限制内访问关键区域。通常，^4D4DFF旗帜1连接到门房^000000。

scripts.text:
{0}
Many flags link directly to
the flag near the Emperium.
The final numbered flag is
linked to the Convenience
Facility of the stronghold's
owner. Keep this in mind.
scripts.translation:
{0}
许多旗帜直接连接到华丽金属附近的旗帜。最后一个编号的旗帜连接到要塞所有者的便利设施。请记住这一点。

scripts.text:
{0}
Strategy? It would be better
to develop your battle plan to
exploit your guild's advantages
and your enemies' weaknesses.
Use the Gate Houses and Barricades, and rebuild as quickly as you can!

{0}
You have no questions
to ask of me? Well, I'm
here to serve your needs.
scripts.translation:
{0}
您没有问题要问我吗？好吧，我在这里为您服务。

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm always here, so
feel free to request my
assistance whenever
the need arises.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我一直在这里，所以随时可以在需要时请求我的协助。

scripts.text: Increase Stronghold Defense
scripts.translation: 增加要塞防御

scripts.text: Situational Briefing
scripts.translation: 情况简报

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
{0}
I'm sorry, but the Guardian
Stones aren't powerful enough
to summon Guardians yet. We
need to accumulate more
knowledge before they can
summon any Guardians.
scripts.translation:
{0}
抱歉，但守护石还不够强大，无法召唤守卫。我们需要积累更多知识才能召唤任何守卫。

scripts.text:
{0}
I shall endeavor to summon
a Guardian through a Guardian
Stone. However, keep in mind
that this will not work if the
Guardian Stone is destroyed.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我将努力通过守护石召唤一名守卫。但是，请记住，如果守护石被摧毁，这将不起作用。

scripts.text:
{0}
You've already commanded
me to summon a Guardian
to defend the stronghold.
scripts.translation:
{0}
您已经命令我召唤一名守卫来保卫要塞。

scripts.text:
{0}
Our defense status is...
1st Guardian Stone: {1}^000000
2nd Guardian Stone: {2}^000000
1st Fortress Gate: {3}^000000
2nd Fortress Gate: {4}^000000
3rd Fortress Gate: {5}^000000

scripts.translation:
{0}
我将待命，等待您的命令。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Welcome, proud member
of the ^FF0000{0}^000000 Guild!
The Kafra Corporation is ready
to assist you wherever you go!
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
欢迎，^FF0000{0}^000000公会的骄傲成员！
卡普拉公司随时准备在您所到之处为您提供帮助！

scripts.text: Use Storage
scripts.translation: 使用仓库

scripts.text: Use Warp Service
scripts.translation: 使用传送服务

scripts.text: Rent Pushcart
scripts.translation: 租赁手推车

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm so sorry, but you must
have at least Novice Skill
Lv.6 to use the Storage.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
非常抱歉，您必须至少拥有初心者技能6级才能使用仓库。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Please tell me your
Warp destination.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
请告诉我您的传送目的地。

scripts.text: Rachel -> 200 z
Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough Zeny to pay
the warp fee. Would you
please check your funds again?
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，但您的泽尼不足以支付传送费用。请您再检查一下您的资金好吗？

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
I'm sorry, but the Pushcart
rental service can only be
used by Merchant, Blacksmith,
and Alchemist class characters.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
抱歉，但手推车租赁服务只能由商人、铁匠和炼金术士职业的角色使用。

scripts.text:
[Kafra Employee]
Hm? You've already
rented a Pushcart.
scripts.translation:
[卡普拉服务员]
嗯？您已经租赁了一辆手推车。

scripts.text:
